description:
## 0.0.22-12 (Muthu build)

Built from Muthu1203-abi/Hushgram on HushGram 0.0.22, synced with SysAdminDoc/HushGram up to 634cb4994. For Instagram 457.0.0.55.73.

* The Liquid Glass navigation bar's switch shows again under HushGram settings > Tab bar, so the bar can be turned on after a fresh install. Turn it on and restart Instagram.
* Run Reels behind the tab bar starts on: only the pill is glass, and the reel shows all round it as the feed does.
* Also in this build: glass sheets and the bar follow Instagram's own theme, and Double tap the top of a reel to share.
